{{Quote|A grown-up version of the kiddie favorite! Indulge your sweet tentacle with one of these giant, crispy squares today. Coated with charmed quark frosting, they're just	about the most decadent treat you can find this side	of the Zabian system!|Dex's Diner menu on its sticky sweetmallow squares|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Quark frosting''' was used to coat the [[sticky sweetmallow square]]s served as part of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|dessert]] menu of the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quark frosting was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
